test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I think your watch / goes ten minutes behind; / mine shows / the correct time.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **goes ten minutes behind**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace '**behind**' with '**slow**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• The word '**slow**' has a specific meaning with **respect to time.**
 
• It refers to a clock or watch showing a time.
 
• **Behind: **later or less good than somebody/something; making less progress than somebody/something.
 
• **Example -** *The train is twenty minutes **behind **schedule.*

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**Corrected sentence:** *I think your watch goes ten minutes slow; mine shows the correct time.*
